results.title: How does export utilities work and how do I save my drawing ? · excalidraw/excalidraw · Discussion #3778
excerpts: As per your question of saving the drawing, I think you are talking about saving it so users can retrieve the same when they come back to the app the way it works in excalidraw app we save to local storage, similarly, you can save it to your preferred storage using the onChange callback, this gives you the elements as well as the appState so you save these to your storage and pass the same using initialData when initializing excalidraw.

# Utils

These are pure Javascript functions exported from the @excalidraw/excalidraw [`@excalidraw/excalidraw`](https://npmjs.com/@excalidraw/excalidraw) . If you want to export your drawings in different formats eg `png` , `svg` and more you can check out Export Utilities . If you want to restore your drawings you can check out Restore Utilities .

### serializeAsJSON ​

Takes the scene elements and state and returns a JSON string. `Deleted` elements as well as most properties from `AppState` are removed from the resulting JSON. (see [`serializeAsJSON()`](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/packages/excalidraw/data/json.ts) source for details).

If you want to overwrite the `source` field in the `JSON` string, you can set `window.
EXCALIDRAW_EXPORT_SOURCE` to the desired value.

**_Signature_**

```
serializeAsJSON({  
  elements:  [ExcalidrawElement[]](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/packages/excalidraw/element/types.ts) ,  
  appState:  [AppState](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/packages/excalidraw/types.ts) ,  
}): string
```

**How to use**

```
import {  serializeAsJSON  } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw" ;
```

### serializeLibraryAsJSON ​

Takes the `library` items and returns a `JSON` string.

If you want to overwrite the source field in the JSON string, you can set `window.EXCALIDRAW_EXPORT_SOURCE` to the desired value.

**_Signature_**

```
serializeLibraryAsJSON( libraryItems:  [LibraryItems[]](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/packages/excalidraw/types.ts) )
```

**How to use**

```
import {  serializeLibraryAsJSON  } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw" ;
```

#### isInvisiblySmallElement ​

Returns `true` if element is invisibly small (e.g.
width & height are zero).

**_Signature_**

```
isInvisiblySmallElement(element:   [ExcalidrawElement](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/packages/excalidraw/element/types.ts) ): boolean
```

**How to use**

```
import {  isInvisiblySmallElement  } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw" ;
```

### loadFromBlob ​

This function loads the scene data from the blob (or file). If you pass `localAppState` , `localAppState` value will be preferred over the `appState` derived from `blob` . Throws if blob doesn't contain valid scene data.

**How to use**

```
import {  loadFromBlob  } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw" ;  
   
 const  scene  = await loadFromBlob ( file , null , null ) ;  
 excalidrawAPI . updateScene ( scene ) ;
```

**Signature**

```
loadFromBlob(  
  blob:  [Blob](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Blob) ,  
  localAppState:  [AppState](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/packages/excalidraw/types.ts)  | null,
localElements:  [ExcalidrawElement[]](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/packages/excalidraw/element/types.ts)  | null,  
  fileHandle?: FileSystemHandle | null   
) => Promise< [RestoredDataState](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/master/packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts) >
```

### loadLibraryFromBlob ​

This function loads the library from the blob. Additonally takes `defaultStatus` param which sets the default status for library item if not present, defaults to `unpublished` .

**How to use**

```
import {  loadLibraryFromBlob  } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw" ;
```

**_Signature_**

```
loadLibraryFromBlob(blob:  [Blob](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Blob) , defaultStatus: "published"

# Does @excalidraw/excalidraw have `exportToJSON`?

- Page: GitHub issue
- URL: https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/3532
- State: closed (completed)
- Author: azu
- Created: 2021-05-04T00:32:30Z
- Updated: 2021-05-11T22:24:42Z
- Repository: excalidraw/excalidraw
- Number: #3532
- Comments: 1
- Linked PRs: #3538 (merged)
- Closed by: https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/pull/3538

## Labels

- package:excalidraw

---

It looks [@excalidraw/excalidraw](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@excalidraw/excalidraw) does not have an export function to create `.excalidraw` file.

I want to get a JSON object(`.excalidraw`) from excalidraw instance to avoiding save dialog.

## Use Case

I'm creating integration with an editor like [Inkdrop](https://www.inkdrop.app/).
I want to save the content as `.excalidraw` automatically when editing the canvas.

illustration of code.

```jsx
       <Excalidraw
          initialData={savedData}
onChange={(elements, state) => {
            const data = { elements, state }; // <= this is invalid format
            writeFile("path/to/file.excalidraw", JSON.stringify(date), "utf-8");
          }}
        />
```

However, `@excalidraw/excalidraw`  does not expose `serializeAsJSON` function.
It normalizes the `elements` and `state`.

https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/blob/5c73c5813ce92d3c7b0610530f78ccb06a47d983/src/data/json.ts

Current workaround: I've copied the `_clear*` logics from excalidraw codebase.

https://github.com/azu/inkdrop-excalidraw/blob/79e1057813b61fe90db227c6bff23c9618fa32ab/src/providers/helper.js

* `lock_elements` / `unlock_elements` \- Lock/unlock elements

### **Resource Access**

* `get_resource` \- Access scene, library, theme, or elements data

### **Export & Download** ✨ NEW!

* `export_canvas` \- Export canvas to PNG or SVG with light/dark theme support

## 🎨 Export Canvas Feature

The export feature allows you to download your Excalidraw canvas in PNG or SVG format with customizable theme options.

### **Using MCP Tool**

```
// Export as PNG with light theme 
 { 
  "format" : "png" , 
  "theme" : "light" , 
  "filename" : "my-diagram" 
 } 

 // Export as SVG with dark theme 
 { 
  "format" : "svg" , 
  "theme" : "dark" , 
  "filename" : "my-dark-diagram" 
 }
```

### **Using Canvas UI**

The canvas interface provides four quick export buttons:

* 📷 **PNG Light** \- Export as PNG with light background
* 🌙 **PNG Dark** \- Export as PNG with dark background
* 📐 **SVG Light** \- Export as SVG with light background
* 🌑 **SVG Dark** \- Export as SVG with dark background

### **Export Options**

|Parameter |Type |Required |Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|`format` |`'png' | 'svg'` |Yes |Export format |
|`theme` |`'light' | 'dark'` |No |Theme mode (default: 'light') |
|`filename` |`string` |No |Custom filename without extension |

### **Features**

* ✅ High-quality PNG exports (95% quality)
* ✅ Vector SVG exports for scalability
* ✅ Automatic dark/light theme switching
* ✅ Custom background colors based on theme
* ✅ Automatic file download in browser
* ✅ Preserves all element properties and styles

## 🏗️ Development Architecture

### **Frontend** ( `frontend/src/` )

* **React + TypeScript** : Modern TSX components with full type safety
* **Vite Build System** : Fast development and optimized production builds
* **Official Excalidraw** : `@excalidraw/excalidraw` package with TypeScript types
* **WebSocket Client** : Type-safe real-time element synchronization
* **Clean UI** : Production-ready interface with proper TypeScript typing

### **Canvas Server** ( `src/server.ts` → `dist/server.js` )

* **TypeScript + Express.js** : Fully typed REST API + static file serving
* **WebSocket** : Type-safe real-time client communication
* **Element Storage** : In-memory with comprehensive type definitions
* **CORS** : Cross-origin support with proper typing

### **MCP Server** ( `src/index.ts` → `dist/index.js` )

* **TypeScript MCP Protocol** : Type-safe Model Context Protocol implementation
* **Canvas Sync** : Strongly typed HTTP requests to canvas server
* **Element Management** : Full CRUD operations with comprehensive type checking
* **Batch Support** : Type-safe complex diagram creation

### **Type System** ( `src/types.ts` )

* **Excalidraw Element Types** : Complete type definitions for all element types
* **API Response Types** : Strongly typed REST API interfaces
* **WebSocket Message Types** : Type-safe real-time communication
